courses.note: Required: CSCI 34000 is on the major's required list and C3 is the algorithms course. Newest public syllabus found is the Fall 2023 course-essentials PDF on an instructor's departmental page (directory also lists Fall 2020 to Spring 2022 versions). Its academic honesty section names generative AI as software whose work counts as dishonesty unless the instructor says otherwise.

notes: Hunter renumbered courses to five digits (CSCI 135 is now CSCI 13500). The department page mixes both forms. No CS course syllabus from Spring 2023 or later was found publicly; current syllabi appear to sit in Blackboard.
